episodes.title: The Nightmare Begins
episodes.summary: Arun, an aspiring filmmaker who researched psycho killers for years, becomes a sub-inspector under family pressure. A 15-year-old girl is found murdered; he sees a serial killer at work, but his superiors refuse to listen.
episodes.cliffhanger: Arun fears for his own niece Ammu, a schoolgirl herself.

episodes.title: Who Is The Real Monster?
episodes.summary: Inbaraj, a teacher at Ammu's school, is exposed as a predator and shot dead by Arun while trying to escape. That night Ammu is abducted from her birthday party and killed. Suspended, Arun finds a piano tune on murdered girl Meera's hearing aid that leads to magician Annabella George, who performed at every victim's school.
episodes.cliffhanger: Annabella George is a fake name. Who is she really?

episodes.title: The Twist You Never Expected
episodes.summary: Retired officer Rajamanickam reveals Annabella George is Mary Fernandez, accused of murder years ago, whose son Christopher, a gifted pianist and magician, was mocked for a rare ageing disease. Mary died in an accident; Christopher kills disguised as her. He attacks Viji and kidnaps her niece Kayal; Arun tracks him down, kills him after a brutal fight and rescues Kayal.
episodes.cliffhanger: The monster is dead and Kayal is safe.
